title: Swimming Pool Filtration Pump Failure
description: The filtration pump motor in Sports Complex has failed. Pool operations suspended. Replacement part has been ordered and is expected to arrive by October 25.

title: Fire Suppression Pressure Anomaly
description: Pressure sensor in Zone 3 of Science Complex fire suppression system is showing intermittent readings. Scheduled inspection for October 25.

title: Library Elevator Vibration Detected
description: Unusual vibration detected in the Main Library elevator system between floors 3 and 4. Technician inspection scheduled for October 30.

title: Shuttle C Taken Out of Service
description: Campus Shuttle C has been taken out of service for routine brake inspection. Expected back in service by October 24.

title: Backup Generator Fuel Level Alert
description: Backup generator fuel level is at 78%. Refueling recommended before next scheduled test on November 10.

title: HVAC Compressor Overheating
description: HVAC compressor unit in Hostel Block 1 reporting temperature 15% above normal operating range. Automatic shutdown triggered to prevent damage.

title: Parking Lot B Camera Maintenance
description: 3 CCTV cameras in Parking Lot B require lens cleaning. Image quality degraded by approximately 30%.

title: Energy Consumption Peak Warning
description: Campus energy consumption exceeded daily average by 3.2% today. Engineering Block A and Hostel Block 1 are the primary contributors.
